name: D2CategoryOptionCodeIdentifierSystem_CS
title: DHIS2 category option codes in use
description: Every DHIS2 category option code this guide's concept maps target, enumerated. D2CategoryOptionCodeIdentifierSystem declares the same URL as an identifier system, which states what the namespace is without listing what is in it; this code system lists it, so a consumer - and the IG publisher - validates a mapped identifier out of the guide rather than against a terminology server.
